info.name: Clio API Documentation Activities Folders API
Return the data of the contents of a Folder

params.name: contact_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single Contact. Use the keyword `null` to match those without a Folder. The list will be filtered to include only the Folder records with the matching property.

params.name: created_since
params.description: Filter Folder records to those having the `created_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.name: document_category_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single DocumentCategory. Use the keyword `null` to match those without a Folder. The list will be filtered to include only the Folder records with the matching property.

params.name: external_property_name
params.description:
Filter records to only those with the given external property(s) name set.

e.g. `?external_property_name=Name`

params.name: external_property_value
params.description:
Filter records to only those with the given external property(s) value set. Requires external property name as well.

e.g. `?external_property_name=Name&external_property_value=Value`

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

params.name: ids[]
params.description: Filter Folder records to those having the specified unique identifiers.

params.name: include_deleted
params.description: Allow trashed Folder record to be included.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of Folder records to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 200. Default: `200`.

params.name: matter_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single Matter. Use the keyword `null` to match those without a Folder. The list will be filtered to include only the Folder records with the matching property.

params.name: order
params.description: Orders the Folder records by the given field. Default: `id(asc)`.

params.name: page_token
params.description: A token specifying which page to return.

params.name: parent_id
params.description:
The unique identifier for a single Folder.

When returning the data of the contents of a Folder, the keyword `null` is not valid for this field. If no Folder is provided, it will default to the account's root Folder.

When returning the data for all Folders, use the keyword `null` to match those without a Folder. The list will be filtered to include only the Folder records with the matching property.

params.name: query
params.description: Wildcard search for `name` matching the given string.

params.name: scope
params.description: Filters Folder record to those being a child of the parent Folder, or a descendant of the parent Folder. Default is `children`.

params.name: show_uncompleted
params.description: Allow Folder record being uploaded to be included.

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Filter Folder records to those having the `updated_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

items.docs:
Return the data of the contents of a Folder.

Note: offset pagination is not supported for this endpoint. Use cursor pagination if you're looking to paginate through the results.

items.docs: Update Folder, move Folder to another Folder, and/or restore a trashed Folder.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier for the Folder.

items.docs:
Deleting a Folder using this method will move it to the trash instead of permanently deleting it. Trashed Folders are permanently deleted after 30 days. The following errors may be returned:

- `400 Bad Request`: The Folder cannot be trashed. The `type` of the error will be `DeleteFailed` and the `message` of the error will be one of the following:
  - `Delete failed: This folder contains more than 100,000 items and cannot be trashed. Please trash some of the items inside it before trying again.
